[0] P=0.1362, flies line FLP1;CAT2B12;SOD3A1 in the short-lived genetic background were used.

[1] P<0.0001, flies line FLP1;CAT2A2;SOD3B2 in the short-lived genetic background were used.

[2] P=0.0136, flies line FLP1;CAT2A2;SOD3B2 in the short-lived genetic background were used.

[3] P<0.0001, flies line FLP1;CAT2B2;SOD3B2 in the short-lived genetic background were used.

[4] P=0.9204 flies line FLP1;CAT2B2;SOD3B2 in the short-lived genetic background were used.

[5] P=0.2892, flies line FLP1;CAT2B12;SOD3B2 in the short-lived genetic background were used.

[6] P=0.002, flies line FLP1;CAT2B12;SOD3B2 in the short-lived genetic background were used.

[7] Significant increases in the activities of both CuZn-SOD had no beneficial effect on survivorship in relatively long-lived mutant flies and were associated with slightly decreased life spans in wild type flies of the Oregon-R strain.

[8] Heterozygous knockout of CAV1 didn't affect mice's lifespan. Life spans are determined from survival curves.

[9] Homozygous knockout of CAV1 reduced mice viability by 50% to the end of the second year of life. CAV1 -/- mice exhibited cardiac pathologies and pulmonary defects compared with wild-type mice of the same age. Life spans are determined from survival curves.

Each numbered passage describes one lifespan experiment. For each, report three things using ONLY that passage:
  organism: the model organism studied, one lowercase word
  direction: exactly one of 'increases lifespan', 'decreases lifespan', or 'no change'
  method: how the gene was altered, e.g. gene knockout, overexpression, mutation, knockdown

Output one block per passage, in order, formatted exactly:
[0]
organism: ...
direction: ...
method: ...

Nothing else. If a passage does not state something, write 'unstated'.
